cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. With what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.
